title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Demon Slayer
content: Demon Slayer ‘s groundbreaking global success is primarily thanks to the anime adaptation by Ufotable. While the manga was already a decent enough success, the anime adaptation helped it reach new heights of popularity that few series had gotten before.
author: ComicBook

title: Light Novel 'Isekai Douraku ni Akitara' Gets TV Anime in Winter 2027
content: Publishing company Shufunotomo announced a television anime adaptation of Fudaya Sanmongarasu and Tomozo 's Isekai Douraku ni Akitara ( Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored ) light novel on Friday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Bleach, Naruto & Classic Shonen Jump Anime Hits Are Now Easier to Stream Than Ever
content: The golden age of Shonen during the 1990s and 2000s saw many promising shows in the industry, but very few could compete with the popularity of One Piece , Naruto , and Bleach .

title: Blue Rights Company Unveils Pilot Film for Orochi -Seventh Echoes- Original Animated Feature
content: Entertainment company BLUE RIGHTS revealed on Friday a pilot film for its original feature-length animated movie titled OROCHI -Seventh Echoes- . The company also revealed the film's teaser visual and main staff. The pilot film features the theme song "Zankyo" performed by neNna .

title: Pokémon’s First Movie Is Still Peak Even After 27 Years
content: With the number of anime series and movies Pokémon has released over the years, fans often find themselves celebrating major milestones throughout the year. However, there’s something special about the first movie that just can’t be beat.

title: Goten & Trunks Need Their Redemption in Dragon Ball Super’s Anime Future
content: Early in their fighting careers it looked like Trunks and Goten were on track to surpass their fathers and take up the mantle of protecting earth in the Dragon Ball universe. Instead, they faded into the background, while Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo and sometimes Gohan continued to raise their respective power levels .
